definitions.explanation: A relatively small number or group compared to the whole.

examples.japanese: {少数|しょうすう}⟦{派|は}→派：28356_ha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The opinions of the minority are also important.

examples.japanese: {少数|しょうすう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{知|し}っている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。

{少数|しょうすう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}{意見|いけん}→反対意見：24246_hantaiiken⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{予定通|よていどお}り→予定通り：15290_yoteidoori⟧⟦{進|すす}められた→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: There were a few opposing voices, but the plan went ahead as scheduled.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {少数|しょうすう}{派|は}: minority group
- {少数|しょうすう}⟦{民族|みんぞく}→民族：13229_minzoku⟧: ethnic minority
- {少数|しょうすう}{精鋭|せいえい}: a small elite group
- {少数|しょうすう}⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧: minority opinion

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{多数|たすう}→多数：05612_tasuu⟧: majority, many (the opposite)
- ⟦{多数決|たすうけつ}→多数決：16369_tasuuketsu⟧: majority vote

WATCH OUT:
The homophone ⟦{小数|しょうすう}→小数：27356_shousuu⟧ means a decimal (⟦{小数点|しょうすうてん}→小数点：30724_shousuuten⟧, decimal point). Writing {少数|しょうすう}⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧ for 'decimal point' is a common mistake.
